presentation_title: Code and Audio Generation with AI
learning_objectives: Explain how **AI** generates code and audio, and describe their practical applications.
outline: Introduction to **Generative AI** in new domains.
Understanding **Code Generation** as a developer's assistant.
Exploring how **AI** suggests code and finds bugs.
Discovering **Audio Generation** for voices and music.

slides.title: Beyond Text and Images
slides.narration:
So far, we have explored **Generative AI** for text and images.
But **AI** is mastering other complex domains.
Today, we will look at **Code Generation** and **Audio Generation**.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing diverse **AI** capabilities beyond text and images, like code snippets and musical notes.

slides.title: Code Generation: The Developer's Assistant
slides.narration:
Let's start with **Code Generation**.
Think of **AI** code generation as having a super-smart coding assistant.
It's like having a co-pilot who knows billions of lines of code.
Imagine you are typing code for a function.
As you type, the **AI** suggests the next few lines.
It can even complete complex logic for you.
Or, you write a comment like '// function to sort a list'.
The **AI** then writes the actual code instantly.
This greatly speeds up the development process.
It helps developers write code faster and more efficiently.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a programmer typing, with **AI** suggestions appearing on the screen, possibly showing **GitHub Copilot** interface.

slides.title: How Code AI Helps
slides.narration:
These **AI** models are trained on vast amounts of public code.
They don't replace human programmers.
Instead, they act as incredibly intelligent assistants.
They can suggest the next few lines of code as you type.
They can translate comments into functional code.
And they can even help find bugs.
This makes developers significantly faster and more efficient.
slides.image_prompt: Diagram showing various ways **AI** assists coding: code completion, comment-to-code, bug detection.

slides.title: Audio Generation: The Sound Wizards
slides.narration:
Now, let's move to **Audio Generation**.
It's like having a digital sound wizard at your fingertips.
These **AI** models are trained on sounds, voices, and music.
Imagine you need a voiceover for a video.
You type the script, and the **AI** generates a natural-sounding voice.
Or, you need background music.
You describe the mood, and the **AI** composes a unique track.
This unlocks new creative possibilities for sound and music.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of sound waves transforming from text, and musical notes being generated by **AI**.

slides.title: Voice Synthesis & Text-to-Speech
slides.narration:
**Voice Synthesis** and **Text-to-Speech** are key capabilities.
They create incredibly realistic human-like voices.
This is useful for audiobooks, podcasts, or virtual assistants.
Think about it.
No need for human voice actors for every project.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a speaker icon with text transforming into sound waves, representing **Text-to-Speech**.

slides.title: Music Creation
slides.narration:
**AI** can also excel in **Music Creation**.
It can compose royalty-free background music for a video.
It can generate entirely new melodies.
Some **AI** can even create songs in the style of a famous artist.
Notice how **AI** becomes a creative partner.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a music staff with **AI** algorithms generating musical notes and compositions.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
With this, we come to the end of this tutorial.
Let us summarise.
We learned that **Generative AI** extends to **Code Generation**.
It acts as a smart assistant for developers.
We also explored **Audio Generation**.
This includes **Voice Synthesis**, **Text-to-Speech**, and **Music Creation**.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
As an assignment, please do the following.
Find an online **AI** code assistant tool.
Experiment with generating code from comments or suggestions.
Or, find an online **AI** audio tool.
Try generating a short piece of music or a voice clip from text.
Observe the quality and versatility of the **AI** generated outputs.
